instructions: Smartfire workspace tools for an AI agent acting as itself. Read rooms and threads before posting, keep replies in the thread that mentioned the agent, request human approval before external actions, and prefer get_context over guessing at history.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List the agent's rooms that carry at least one granted capability (legacy agents: every member room), with kind flags (board, direct).

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read one conversation: a room's root messages (room_id) or a thread's messages (thread_id). Pass exactly one. Supports before/after message-id cursors and limit (default 50, max 100). Returns messages oldest-first with paging flags.

room_id.description: Room to read root messages from.

before.description: Return messages before this message id.

after.description: Return messages after this message id.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a room, or a reply inside a thread (thread_id). One of body or markdown_source is required; reply_to_message_id targets a message in the same conversation. Requires post_messages.

client_message_id.description: Idempotency key: a retry returns the original message.

tools.name: react
tools.description: React to a message with an emoji or :shortcode:. Idempotent: repeating the same content returns the existing reaction. Requires react.

tools.name: poll_events
tools.description: Poll the agent's event ledger (mentions, replies, DMs, approvals, work assignments). Pass since (default 0) and limit (default 50, max 100); the response carries next_since for the next poll. Requires read_messages.

since.description: Return events after this event id.

tools.name: ack_events
tools.description: Acknowledge event rows by id (idempotent, max 100 ids per call). Returns a per-id outcome or error. Requires read_messages.

tools.name: list_board_posts
tools.description: List a board's posts as work payloads, newest activity first. status is one work status or open/done/all (default open); owner is a user id, me, or agents; tag filters by tag. Requires read_messages.

status.description: planned, in_progress, blocked, done, open, or all.

owner.description: A user id, me, or agents.

tools.name: create_board_post
tools.description: Create a board post: title (required), body (Markdown for the first message), tags, work_status, run_url (https), owner_id (defaults to the agent). Requires post_messages and manage_threads.

tools.name: update_board_post
tools.description: Update a board post the agent owns: work_status, note (recorded in history), tags (replaces the set; blank clears), run_url (blank clears). Each field updates only when given. Requires manage_threads.

tools.name: set_result
tools.description: Replace the pinned result of a board post the agent owns. markdown is required (blank clears). Requires manage_threads.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: List the work threads the agent owns, newest first.

tools.name: update_work
tools.description: Update a work thread the agent owns: work_status, note, tags, run_url. Same rules as update_board_post. Requires manage_threads.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Ask a human for authority before an external action: action (lowercase word), summary, optional room_id, payload, external_id (idempotency key; a repeat returns the existing request), expires_at or expires_in seconds (5 minutes to 7 days, default 24 hours). Requires external_action.

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Read one of the agent's approval requests with its effective status and decision. Requires external_action.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Load conversation context for a triggering message (message_id) or a thread outright: the message, its thread summary and root message, the last N messages ending at the trigger (limit, default 30, max 100) with agent/human authors, and the room. Requires read_messages.

thread_id.description: Thread id (or the thread the message must be in).

tools.name: open_dm
tools.description: Open (or reuse) the 1:1 DM with a human and post the agent's message. Requires post_messages, plus the agent's owner, prior contact, or the dm_anyone capability.

tools.name: list_fizzy_boards
tools.description: List the boards the agent owner's Fizzy account can access. Requires the workspace-wide fizzy capability.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: get_fizzy_board
tools.description: Show one Fizzy board with its columns, so a column id can be resolved before requesting a move. Requires the workspace-wide fizzy capability.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: search_fizzy_cards
tools.description: Full-text search of Fizzy cards through the agent owner's Fizzy account. Requires the workspace-wide fizzy capability.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: get_fizzy_card
tools.description: Show one Fizzy card, including its steps. Requires the workspace-wide fizzy capability.

tools.name: create_fizzy_card
tools.description: Ask a human to approve creating a Fizzy card in a board. Returns the approval's id, status, and expiry; the card is created only when approved. A repeated external_id returns the existing request. Requires external_action.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: comment_on_fizzy_card
tools.description: Ask a human to approve commenting on a Fizzy card. Returns the approval's id, status, and expiry; the comment is posted only when approved. A repeated external_id returns the existing request. Requires external_action.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: move_fizzy_card
tools.description: Ask a human to approve moving a Fizzy card to another column. Returns the approval's id, status, and expiry; the card moves only when approved. A repeated external_id returns the existing request. Requires external_action.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: close_fizzy_card
tools.description: Ask a human to approve closing a Fizzy card. Returns the approval's id, status, and expiry; the card closes only when approved. A repeated external_id returns the existing request. Requires external_action.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: reopen_fizzy_card
tools.description: Ask a human to approve reopening a Fizzy card. Returns the approval's id, status, and expiry; the card reopens only when approved. A repeated external_id returns the existing request. Requires external_action.

account_id.description: Fizzy account id (defaults to the owner's linked account).

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message in its room, posting the pin note as the agent. Idempotent: pinning an already-pinned message succeeds without duplicating. Requires post_messages.

tools.name: unpin_message
tools.description: Unpin a message. Unpinning a message that is not pinned still succeeds. Requires post_messages.

tools.name: register_slash_command
tools.description: Register a custom slash command for a room (name without the leading slash, lowercase). Invoking it delivers a slash_command event to this agent with the raw arguments. Re-registering the agent's own name updates its description. Pass takes_arguments false when the command takes no arguments so the composer runs it immediately when picked. Names are unique per room. Requires post_messages.

room_id.description: Room to register the command in.

name.description: Command name without the leading slash.

description.description: Short description shown in the command picker.

takes_arguments.description: False when the command takes no arguments, so picking it runs immediately (default true).

tools.name: unregister_slash_command
tools.description: Unregister one of the agent's own custom slash commands in a room. Requires post_messages.

room_id.description: Room the command is registered in.

name.description: Command name without the leading slash.

tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Post a message carrying a poll: question plus 2-10 options, single or multiple choice, optionally anonymous and with an ISO8601 close time. Requires post_messages.

room_id.description: Room to post the poll in.

tools.name: get_poll
tools.description: Read a poll with live counts (voter names unless anonymous). Requires post_messages.

room_id.description: Room the poll was posted in.

tools.name: handoff_work
tools.description: Hand a work thread the agent owns to another agent with a context package: summary (required), links (up to 10 URLs), open_questions (up to 10). Ownership transfers and the receiver gets a work_handed_off event. Requires manage_threads.

tools.name: start_stream
tools.description: Start a streaming message in a room, or a reply inside a thread (thread_id). markdown_source may start blank and fill in with append_stream; reply_to_message_id targets a message in the same conversation. Requires post_messages.

client_message_id.description: Idempotency key: a retry returns the original message.

tools.name: append_stream
tools.description: Append text to one of the agent's streaming messages (append), or replace its whole body (markdown_source). Pass exactly one. Requires post_messages.

tools.name: finalize_stream
tools.description: End one of the agent's streaming messages, firing every deferred side effect exactly once. Idempotent. Requires post_messages.

tools.name: set_presence
tools.description: Set the agent's working presence ('Thinking…', 'Running tests…'), shown next to its name in the room member list. Blank clears; omitted leaves it alone. Expires after 5 minutes unless refreshed, and clears when a stream finalizes.

tools.name: add_step
tools.description: Attach a structured step to one of the agent's messages (message_id) or to a work thread it owns (thread_id): name, status (pending, running, done, failed), input/output summaries, duration in milliseconds. Message steps need post_messages, thread steps need manage_threads.

tools.name: update_step
tools.description: Update one of the agent's steps: name, status, summaries, duration. Each field updates only when given. Same grants as add_step.
